palette: cream field + terracotta cinder track + chalk white + warm black + start-flash amber + graphite preparation gray
typography: heavy athletic sans headlines, ghost lane numerals, chalk-style label blocks, square verdict stamps
composition: running-track straightaways where each crime owns a lane and its start line sits at a different distance: preparation blocks before the line, one lit start gate on the line, running phase after it
surface: cinder track bands, chalk lane lines, dashed starting blocks, photo-finish review strips, paper evidence cards; no glossy panels
motion: lanes enter in legal-reasoning order, each start line flashes once when its gun fires, negation marks land beside the text; no idle loops
transition: the lit start gate persists as the carrier while each scene re-stages the same straightaway for a new question
